What will you be doing? As a Field Service Engineer, you will be the technical point of contact for customers. You will ensure that their packaging machines operate safely, reliably and efficiently. Carrying out machine modifications, upgrades and conversions. Providing both on-site and remote technical support. Performing preventive maintenance to reduce downtime and improve machine availability. Monitoring machine performance and identifying potential technical issues at an early stage. Advising customers and sharing technical expertise to solve operational problems. Training customer employees in the correct operation and maintenance of the machinery. Preparing accurate service, quality and installation reports. Maintaining clear communication with customers and the Field Service Manager. Identifying possible commercial opportunities or risks during customer visits. Working closely with a

experienced and internationally oriented Field Service team. Most assignments will take place in the Benelux and Scandinavia. Experience with industrial machinery, production equipment or packaging machines. Experience with troubleshooting, commissioning and preventive maintenance. Knowledge of Siemens S7 and TIA Portal is an advantage. Knowledge of Bosch Rexroth servo systems is an advantage. Good written and spoken English. A valid driving licence. The willingness to travel regularly throughout the Benelux, Scandinavia and other parts of Europe. Availability to travel up to approximately 75% of your working time by car or aeroplane.
